claims.statement: Joe Goss said Tom Allen had authorized William Allen of Cincinnati to make a match.
claims.excerpt: William Allen of Cincinnati to iInake a match

claims.statement: Tom Allen put up a forfeit (printed as 3500, probably $500), which John Brown of Cincinnati, an admirer of Goss, covered.
claims.excerpt: Allen met John Brown of the same city, anardent admirer of Goss, and put up a forfeit

claims.statement: Eph. Holland of Cincinnati was chosen stakeholder for the forfeit money.

notes: Account is Joe Goss's statement to a reporter, reprinted from the New York Sun; the 'Allen' who put up the forfeit is not qualified in the text.
